# Moonrain: Sleep Sounds

> A free, fully offline sleep-sound mixer for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs. No account, no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases and no tracking. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789770084

Moonrain is made by a solo developer. Current version: 1.3 (November 2026). Requires iOS 17 or later. The App Store page is in English and Traditional Chinese; the app interface is in English.

## Features

- 28 ambient sounds: rain, ocean, forest, fire, fans, trains, and brown, pink and white noise
- Mix up to four sounds with independent volumes
- Describe a Mix: type a description such as "rain on a tent with a campfire" in the Mixer and Moonrain picks the sounds. The words are matched on the phone, in English; nothing is sent anywhere
- Sleep timer that fades everything out
- Relax: wind down, body scan, a breathing guide with a soft tone, and 8 whispered ASMR experiences in 3D sound
- Meditation timer of 5 to 60 minutes with Tibetan, crystal and deep singing bowls, an optional interval bell and an ending bell
- Environments for work or study: coffee shop, library, park, rainy tea house and train, plus a noise lab. Sessions of 25, 50 or 90 minutes, or focus cycles of 25 minutes with 5 minute breaks
- Presets, saved mixes and Environments places show up in iPhone search
- A Moonrain Focus filter can open Environments when a Work Focus starts
- Gentle wake alarm that fades in birdsong, a stream or wind chimes over two minutes
- Dim bedside clock with a red night light, and an OK-to-wake clock for kids that shows a red moon until wake time, then a green sun
- Day Sleeper mode for people who sleep during the day, for example after a night shift
- Save mixes, share them as a link or QR code, back them up, or export one as an audio file of 30 minutes, 1 hour or 8 hours
- Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, Control Center controls and Siri
- Simple Mode with large text and one big play button
- Plays all night with the screen locked

## New in version 1.3 (2 November 2026)

- Describe a Mix
- Presets, saved mixes and Environments places in iPhone search
- The Focus filter can open Environments when a Work Focus starts
- Larger text, VoiceOver and contrast fixes
- The system alarm always rings at wake time, and the sleep mix stays off after it is dismissed
